purpose: Keep FIELD INDEX usable under growth: default to fast newest-first re-entry, while preserving attention, lineage, structure, unresolved interfaces, issues and alternate projections as separate readings.
laws: ATTENTION ≠ RECENCY. /control/CURRENT.json owns NOW; route.index.updated_at records mutation evidence only.
MAP ≠ BACKLOG. A route may exist without being active, owed, important or scheduled.
DONOR ≠ HEAD. Recovered and transfer-capable artifacts remain discoverable without competing for current-head status.
DISCUSSION ≠ INDEX TOUCH. A chat/thread mention does not change FIELD INDEX activity by itself.
MUTATION → INDEX TOUCH. Any committed change to a tracked public surface updates that route's index.updated_at in the same bounded repo change.
ACTIVITY MODE ≠ OPERATION. Operation names what the artifact does; work_modes name what kind of work produced the current delta.
SPECULATION IS LEGIBLE, NOT PROMOTED. SPECULATE/SPECIFY may be indexed without implying implementation or evidence.
RECEIPT WHEN CLAIM CHANGES. If implementation/test/release status changes, update or create the relevant receipt and RETURN entry.
ADDRESS EVERY SURFACE; PROMOTE ALMOST NONE. Every directory index surface gets a manifest address or explicit alias disposition; sitemap inclusion never implies NOW, HEAD, priority or canon.
RETURN ≠ NEXT. RETURN closes and exposes evidence; every subsequent move is a fresh replan, not inherited route authority.
RECONSTRUCTION > NARRATION. Promote cross-lineage mechanisms only after a fresh process can reproduce the claimed behavior from durable state or an equivalent bounded test.
EXPERIMENT ≠ STATE. Experimental form is route.kind/operation; lifecycle state must say what can lawfully happen next.
EVOLUTION REQUIRES A HOST. A live experiment exists to change, transfer into, or falsify something outside itself; no ownerless experiment may accumulate roadmap authority.
CHRONOLOGY MAY REPEAT IDENTITY. LATEST may show a route already present in NOW or HEADS because re-entry from recent mutation is a different task from canonical identity display.
DENSITY IS A PROJECTION. MARK / COMPACT / FULL may change information density but never identity, state, authority, order or target.
PROSE PAYS RENT. Fixed prose may not occupy persistent root space when the same function can survive as a mark with explicit reveal.

root_order.meaning: Root human re-entry defaults to newest durable route touches. STRUCTURE/VISUAL are named projections for orientation, not the mandatory first navigation path.

activity_modes.RECOVER: Retrieve exact prior artifacts/lineage before synthesis.
activity_modes.INVESTIGATE: Resolve a bounded uncertainty, identity, mechanism or failure through targeted evidence.
activity_modes.RESEARCH: Gather/synthesize external or corpus evidence; output may be a research note/paper without implementation.
activity_modes.SPECULATE: Generate explicitly hypothetical/theoretical possibilities; no implementation/evidence claim.
activity_modes.SPECIFY: Turn an idea/finding into a bounded model, contract, schema or testable design.
activity_modes.IMPLEMENT: Create or materially change executable/physical artifact state.
activity_modes.VERIFY: Test, measure, audit or compare a claimed behavior/state.
activity_modes.OPERATE: Run, coordinate or maintain a live/current system without necessarily changing its design.
activity_modes.RELEASE: Surface/publish/promote a verified artifact or stable public projection.
activity_modes.UNKNOWN: Legacy/unclassified activity; valid only during migration.

required_same_change: set route.index.work_modes to the modes actually exercised by the delta
update receipt/RETURN only when the claimed artifact/test/release state changed
do_not_touch_when: recovering context but not yet committing recovered state

ui_contract.root_now: Render CURRENT.active_fronts as a compact semantic FIELD strip, not a three-card dashboard. At MARK density, active fronts and retained heads may reduce to glyphs; full objective prose appears only on explicit reveal.
ui_contract.root_heads: Keep CURRENT.current_heads available as a collapsed advanced lineage reading; ordinary navigation must not require understanding the head model.
ui_contract.root_map: Render repository directory index surfaces from manifest parent relations as a searchable collapsed tree. Every directory index surface must have a manifest address; redirect/lens doors use kind=alias. Sitemap completeness never implies priority.
ui_contract.root_recent: Expose index.updated_at as a secondary RECENT lens, never the default ordering.
ui_contract.root_frontier: Derive OPEN PORTS live from route.field.exit_paths; never maintain a duplicate hand-written backlog of the same exits.
ui_contract.corner_nav: Shared showcase route adapter remains the canonical BACK/PARENT/SHOWCASE control on tracked non-root routes.
ui_contract.style: Presentation/theme controls are a separate cross-site concern and must not alter semantic ordering/state.
ui_contract.root_visual: VISUAL is the default human sitemap projection: navigable parent/child field graph over manifest identity. STRUCTURE remains the exhaustive textual reading.
ui_contract.root_pulse: PULSE is a secondary DataDisc-derived mutation spiral over route.index.updated_at. It must never imply priority, semantic proximity or ancestry.
ui_contract.root_move_gate: Render CURRENT.execution_contract as a compact MOVE GATE adjacent to NOW: one bounded move → evidence-bearing RETURN → explicit replan. It is a control law, not another project/front.
ui_contract.root_scale: VISUAL exposes explicit SCALE − / ROOT controls. Scale is parent-child address depth, not CSS zoom: changing scale changes the projection neighborhood while preserving route identity.
ui_contract.root_scale_lens_handoff: Selected MAP route may be copied locally into SCALE LENS via scale.lens.handoff.v01. This is a projection handoff; Lens cannot mutate canonical FIELD manifest state.
ui_contract.root_play: /field-play.html derives public-safe missions from manifest gaps plus FIELD_ISSUES entries with play_safe=true. Returns remain report-only and require review.
ui_contract.root_evolve: EVOLVE is a named projection over canonical manifest routes carrying route.evolution. It shows host, generation, stage, mutation and evidence gate; it is not a new backlog or authority source.
ui_contract.root_identity_fold: SUPERSEDED for LATEST. Identity folding may still be used inside projections where repetition harms legibility, but never to remove recent mutations from the primary re-entry list.
ui_contract.root_latest: Render a newest-first linear list of durable route touches near the top of FIELD INDEX. Do not fold out NOW/HEAD routes. The same list must compress into a semantic glyph rail generated from route state/kind/operation.
ui_contract.root_issues: Render open GitHub issues as a separate newest-activity-first repo-truth list. Live GitHub API may refresh a checked-in /control/FIELD_ISSUES.json fallback. Issue presence is not priority.
ui_contract.root_density: /field-presentation.js applies MARK / COMPACT / FULL from available viewport width. This is a representation projection, not a separate mobile/desktop information architecture.
ui_contract.root_glyph: /field-glyph.js composes marks from route kind × operation × state × NOW/HEAD/ISSUE attention marks. Every mark must target/reveal the same route identity as its full representation.

BOTTLENECK.rule: Return every declared exit whose status is not AVAILABLE. Filtering never changes route or evidence state.
BOTTLENECK.non_claim: Unresolved exit status exposes interface/proof debt; it is not an automatic priority ranking or evidence that an adapter works.

RETURN.rule: RETURN closes the authority of the just-executed move. Any subsequent move is selected again from returned state.
RETURN.non_claim: A RETURN may suggest next routes but does not authorize or autoplay them.

route_state_contract.law: route.kind answers what a surface is; route.state answers its current lifecycle/evidence posture. EXPERIMENT remains a valid kind but is deprecated as a route.state.

states.STABLE: Verified or settled public surface; ordinary use does not require an outstanding named proof gate.
states.ACTIVE: Current runnable/operational head. May still have bounded limitations or unresolved exits.
states.PROOF_REQUIRED: Runnable/specifiable surface whose own named promotion or consequence claim is blocked on explicit evidence.
states.CANDIDATE: Bounded candidate model/orientation that is intentionally revisable and not canonical.
states.REFERENCE: Runnable/reference fixture used to inspect or compare a mechanism; not itself proof of a live adapter or deployment.
states.PARKED: Preserved runnable/comparison surface with no current execution obligation; resume only on a named dependency.
states.DONOR: Useful surviving mechanism/source whose current role is transfer into another head rather than independent advancement.
states.FROZEN_DONOR: Exact recovered donor preserved against in-place modernization; transfer only named mechanisms while keeping source bytes/identity intact.
states.RECOVER: Known gap or partial recovery where exact source/evidence is still required.
states.UTILITY: Validator/docs/support surface rather than a product/head lifecycle.

rules: Do not use EXPERIMENT as a substitute for uncertainty, lack of proof, parking, donor status or active use.
Put experimental form in route.kind or the release hypothesis/known_limits.
Put unresolved consequence/proof requirements in route.field.exit_paths and PROOF_REQUIRED when they block the artifact's own promotion claim.
Historical release receipts may retain their contemporaneous state; append current classification rather than rewriting provenance.

NOW.meaning: At most three attention/execution fronts. This is the only root reading that implies current focus.

HEADS.meaning: Collapsed advanced lineage reading. Retained heads remain recoverable without occupying primary navigation.

MAP.meaning: Durable public address graph using parent relations and lifecycle state. Existence is not priority.

OPEN_PORTS.meaning: Declared interface/proof debt. Open ports are selectors/questions, not an automatic backlog.

RECENT.meaning: Secondary mutation-history reading only. Recent touch never overrides CURRENT attention.

EVOLVE.meaning: Bounded evolutionary work: host → question → one mutation → evidence gate → transfer/park/compost. It is a projection over canonical routes, not a separate queue.

LATEST.meaning: Primary human re-entry: newest durable route mutations first. Duplication with NOW/HEADS is intentional.

ISSUES.meaning: Declared repo open loops. Visibility is not priority or authority.

evolution_contract.purpose: Turn experimental work into bounded variation → evidence → selection → transfer rather than a permanent bucket of prototypes.
evolution_contract.carrier: showcase-manifest route.evolution; do not maintain a separate experiment registry.
evolution_contract.applies_to: Any live route whose kind=experiment and state is not DONOR/FROZEN_DONOR, plus candidate workbenches intentionally enrolled in evolution.

stages.SEED: Define host, question, baseline, one mutation and evidence gate before expanding implementation.
stages.TEST: Run the smallest comparator that can change the experiment's disposition.
stages.SELECT: Evidence exists; choose pass/fail/ambiguous explicitly before more mutation.
stages.TRANSFER: Move only the surviving mechanism into the named host; the experiment itself does not automatically become a new sovereign product.
stages.HOLD: No present work. Resume only on a named dependency or explicit selection.
stages.COMPOST: Failed/superseded branch is retained as negative knowledge or donor residue; no beautification debt.

laws: ONE MUTATION PER GENERATION. If multiple mechanisms change, split or reset the generation.
BASELINE BEFORE NOVELTY. Every test names the plain/current comparator it must beat or materially differ from.
PASS MEANS TRANSFER, NOT EMPIRE. A successful experiment normally donates a mechanism to its host; it does not earn an independent roadmap by default.
FAILURE RETURNS VALUE. A failed branch becomes PARKED/DONOR/COMPOST with its evidence retained so the same idea is not rediscovered from zero.
NO SECOND GENERATION WITHOUT RETURN. Evidence closes the current generation; a new mutation requires explicit replan.
PHYSICAL CLAIMS REQUIRE PHYSICAL RECEIPTS. Digital proxies can prepare but never satisfy a physical correspondence claim.
evolution_contract.host_rule: host must resolve to an existing manifest route and names the recipient/authority that would change if the experiment succeeds.
